name: Ethan Dalamar
source:
Ethan is Justin's best friend. He’s extremely protective of Justin - although he loves nothing more than to tease him! It's a wonder how Ethan hasn't noticed Justin's obvious crush on him, but then again he's been too busy trying to set Justin up with any girl he can before prom. 

With his final high school performance around the corner, Justin is excited to let loose and spend more time with his friends, so he takes advantage of Rachael's party to reconnect and unwind.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/welcome-ethan-47603350]character introduction[/url]]
